newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Oct trade deficit grows to $443 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Oct trade deficit grows to $443 mln.

text.p: Pakistan's trade deficit rose to a provisional $443 million in October from $264 million in September and $415 million in October 1995, the Federal Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
Exports decreased 3.1 percent to a provisional $658 million in October from $679 million in September, but increased 20.7 percent over exports worth $545 million in October 1995.
Imports increased 16.8 percent to $1.101 billion in October from $943 million in September and by 14.7 percent compared to imports worth $960 million in October 1995.

The trade gap in the first four months of fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) fell to a provisional $1.197 billion from $1.403 billion in the year-ago period. Main exports were cotton yarn, fabrics, garments and rice. Main imports were machinery, wheat, chemicals and petroleum products. -- Tahir Ikram 9251-274757
